title: Derived scalar descent of Kummer-normalized vector integration traces
statement:
Let $N\geq1$, let $\varphi:A\to A'$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by $N$, and let $B$ be a Noetherian scheme on which $N$ is invertible. Let $\pi:E\to B$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $r\geq0$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Use ordinary small-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived scalar tensor $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^LA'$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and the canonical proper/open compact-support scalar map $q_{f,M}:Q_YRf_{!,A}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{!,A'}Q_XM$ for compactifiable separated finite-type $f:X\to Y$ [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. Let $u_T:Q_TA_T\xrightarrow{\sim}A'_T$ be multiplication, and let $l_{T,d}:Q_T(A_T(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}A'_T(d)[2d]$ be the normalized ordinary Tate balancing isomorphism of [lem-pur-finite-tate-scalar-source-normalization].

For $p:\mathbf P^1_B\to B$, put $W_R=R_{\mathbf P^1_B}(1)[2]$ for $R=A,A'$. Let $h_R:R_B\to Rp_{*,R}W_R$ be the scalar-extended Kummer class of $\mathcal O(1)$, and $b_R:R_B(1)[2]\oplus R_B\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*,R}W_R$ the decomposition with components the shifted twisted unit and $h_R$ [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction]. Define $\widetilde q_{p,W_A}=Rp_{*,A'}(l_{\mathbf P^1_B,1})q_{p,W_A}$, and let $d_B:Q_B(A_B(1)[2]\oplus A_B)\xrightarrow{\sim}A'_B(1)[2]\oplus A'_B$ have components $l_{B,1}$ and $u_B$. Then
$$\widetilde q_{p,W_A}Q_B(h_A)=h_{A'}u_B,\qquad \widetilde q_{p,W_A}Q_B(b_A)=b_{A'}d_B.$$
Consequently the actual projective-line traces $t_{p,R}=\operatorname{pr}_2b_R^{-1}$ [def-amb-p1-trace] satisfy
$$t_{p,A'}\widetilde q_{p,W_A}=u_BQ_B(t_{p,A}).$$
The affine-space coordinate-tower traces [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace] satisfy this same equation for every dimension $d\geq0$, using the specified compactification scalar comparison. For the global integrations [def-amb-vector-integration], put $W=A_E(r)[2r]$, $W'=A'_E(r)[2r]$ and $\widetilde q_{\pi,W}=R\pi_{!,A'}(l_{E,r})q_{\pi,W}$. Then
$$t_{\pi,A'}\widetilde q_{\pi,W}=u_BQ_B(t_{\pi,A}).$$
This is an equality of derived morphisms, with the actual open-restriction and compactification-refinement comparisons in $q$. It includes rank zero and the empty base. No flatness of $A'$ over $A$, assertion about scalar extension of individual cohomology groups, or general smooth-purity theorem is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain the twisted-unit and Kummer-column equations from projective_components. Derived scalar extension is additive, since it is the left adjoint of derived restriction of scalars. Use its binary-biproduct comparison and biproduct hom extensionality to assemble the two column equations into the decomposition square.

proof.text: The trace is the inverse decomposition followed by the second projection. Precompose the desired trace square by Q(decomposition.hom), apply the decomposition square, and cancel the two inverse pairs. The second projection of sum is Q(snd) followed by unit. This is the private trace_square proof, followed by projective_trace_square.

proof.text: Apply affine_of_projective to the projective trace equation, uniformly over every Noetherian base. This gives all ordered affine scalar squares. Apply frame_scalar_square to get the vector scalar square after restriction to each specified trivializing open.

source.place: Paragraph 2: coefficient compatibility, projective Kummer normalization, affine induction and bundle-frame descent.

proof.text: The finite locally free module admits a Zariski cover with frames. The already proved geometric trace descent gives that vectorBundleIntegration_A is invertible. Its scalar extension followed by the invertible scalar unit therefore identifies the common source of the desired equality with the constant coefficient object in degree zero. This uses no arbitrary local-to-global statement about derived morphisms.

source.place: Paragraph 2: coefficient compatibility, projective Kummer normalization, affine induction and bundle-frame descent.

proof.text: Precompose both vector maps with the inverse of this source identification. Fullness of the single functor writes them as images of sheaf maps. etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv_map and naturality of upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction turn the framed restrictions into equal pullbacks of those sheaf maps. Joint surjectivity of the open cover implies that inverse-image functors jointly reflect isomorphisms, hence are jointly faithful. Thus the sheaf maps agree; faithfulness of single and cancellation give the global equation. Package this with the Kummer equation, decomposition, projective trace and affine equations into the unchanged fivefold conjunction.

theorem vectorTraceScalarDescent (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (φ : A →+* B)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (r : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r] :
    ((scalarExtension φ S).map (ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward A N hA S
        (projectiveLineTraceDatum N hN A hA S hS).chern) ≫
      projective φ N hN hA hB S hS =
      unit φ S ≫ ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward B N hB S
        (projectiveLineTraceDatum N hN B hB S hS).chern) ∧
    ((scalarExtension φ S).map (projectiveLineTraceDatum N hN A hA S hS).decomposition.hom ≫
      projective φ N hN hA hB S hS =
      sum φ N hN hA hB S hS ≫ (projectiveLineTraceDatum N hN B hB S hS).decomposition.hom) ∧
    (projective φ N hN hA hB S hS ≫ projectiveLineTrace N hN B hB S hS =
      (scalarExtension φ S).map (projectiveLineTrace N hN A hA S hS) ≫ unit φ S) ∧
    (∀ d : ℕ, affine φ N hN hA hB S hS d ≫ affineTrace N hN B hB S hS d =
      (scalarExtension φ S).map (affineTrace N hN A hA S hS d) ≫ unit φ S) ∧
    (vector φ N hN hA hB S hS r F ≫ vectorBundleIntegration N hN B hB S hS r F =
      (scalarExtension φ S).map (vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS r F) ≫ unit φ S)
